patch_description:
Replace independent per-destination shortest paths with a greedy directed broadcast-tree construction. The algorithm repeatedly attaches the destination that can be reached with the lowest additional network cost from any node already receiving the broadcast. Once an intermediate node has received data, it becomes a free relay point for subsequent destinations, avoiding repeated source-to-relay transfers.

The resulting tree is expanded into the existing per-destination path representation so that BroadCastTopology remains compatible. Every partition uses the same low-cost relay tree, preserving parallel partition transfers while ensuring that shared prefixes and intermediate relays are reused rather than independently recreated for every destination. Edges without usable costs are excluded before routing, preventing incomplete cost-grid entries from being selected.
